Choose <cg>any</c> of the buttons on <cp>CreatorLayer</c> (the menu that shows when you click this button ![insert the button here](frame:GJ_creatorBtn_001.png?scale=0.2)) to be on the main menu, conveniently located right underneath the creator button ;3

### <cg>Choose between</c>:

- Search
- My Levels
- Saved
- Leaderboards
- Daily
- Weekly
- Event
- Gauntlets
- Featured
- Lists
- Paths
- Map Packs
- Quests
